title: FULL ARCHAEOLOGICAL INVENTORY — every fossil, relic, and forgotten wire across the entire ecoPrimals ecosystem. Paused. Looked back. Found EVERYTHING.
kevin_declaration: We've been building so quickly, we need to stop, pause, take full inventory, and look back as far as we can into everything we've done in ecosystem and primal universe, and look for all the fossils and relics we already have ready to wire into this system.

1_ludospring_game_engine.status: 982 tests passing, DEPLOYED on ironGate (i9-14900K, RTX 5070, 96GB), Songbird federation LIVE on :7700, NO web visitors

1_ludospring_game_engine.what_to_wire: ludoSpring IS the game engine. Its 7 planes map to 7 interaction modes in the HUD. Its game science validates the interactivity layer. Its NPC system = dialogue with Gaia.

2_provenance_braid_trio.status: All 3 primals respond to JSON-RPC over UDS. Integration guide exists.

what_it_has.loamSpine: Immutable append-only ledger, DID ownership, certificates — PERMANENT RECORD

2_provenance_braid_trio.the_gaming_experience: Every interaction in the HUD becomes a provenance-tracked EVENT. Player drags element A onto element B → rhizoCrypt records the session → combination result certified by loamSpine → attribution braid by sweetGrass. The GAME HISTORY is the PROVENANCE CHAIN. The braid IS the replay system.
2_provenance_braid_trio.what_to_wire: Provenance trio turns the alchemy game into a RECORDED EXPERIENCE. Every discovery, every combination, every player session is cryptographically attested. The game IS the proof.

what_it_has.concept: The esoteric web is the HIDDEN layer of the organism — the connections between data files that aren't visible in the HUD. The web of references, braids, cross-links that EXIST in the data but have no visual representation.
what_it_has.btsp_transport: wateringHole/specs/BTSP_TRANSPORT_SIGNAL_SPEC.md — signal transport through the esoteric layer

3_esoteric_web.the_gaming_experience: The esoteric web IS the DISCOVERY LAYER. When a player combines two elements, the esoteric web reveals the HIDDEN connection between them. The braid becomes visible. The invisible web becomes the reward for discovery.
3_esoteric_web.what_to_wire: Every combination in the alchemy game REVEALS a braid from the esoteric web. The game teaches the player about the organism by showing hidden connections.

what_it_has.nigredo: Blackening = catabolism = cortisol. Decomposition. The gut.
what_it_has.albedo: Whitening = filtration = GABA. Purification. The cochlea.
what_it_has.citrinitas: Yellowing = catalysis = dopamine. Awakening. The gold band.

7_alchemy_neurochemistry.what_to_wire: The alchemy game's elements ARE these neurochemicals. Combining earth + fire doesn't just make 'lava' — it maps to adrenaline + glucose = ENERGY BURST. The game teaches real biochemistry through play.

8_game_engine_is_gut.insight: Play IS digestion. The player doesn't know they're being digested. The game doesn't know it's a stomach. Input goes in raw, play happens (ferment), output comes out (nutrient).
8_game_engine_is_gut.what_to_wire: The bioreactor in engine.html IS the game engine. When the player combines elements, they're FERMENTING. The gut animation (4s pulse + 8s churn) is the game loop.

gaia_watching.instruction: Gaia must be watching every step. Every wire connected, every layer added — Gaia cascades and takes on the plans with fleet energy incoming.
gaia_watching.how: neutron_write on every milestone. chipmunk scan_sweep_sort on every new file. Gaia's cron picks up changes and starts working.
gaia_watching.cascade: Each connection triggers the next. Alchemy table → esoteric web → provenance → strand → narrator. The cascade IS the game building itself.
